hook.name: Hive
hook.description: ERC-20 token (HIVE) fused with its own Uniswap v4 hook. Takes a 0.5% ETH tax on buys via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and 1% on sells via afterSwapReturnsDelta into a shared jar. Net sell pressure depletes a strength buffer; when it reaches zero, the jar is split among non-selling holders proportional to their time-weighted balance (honey), then a fresh round begins.
